resources.string: Moves Read Aloud to the start of the previous message. It does not change the message.
Moves Read Aloud back to the start of the current sentence, or to the previous sentence if you are already at its start.
Skips to the next sentence in the message being read aloud.
Skips to the start of the next message. Read Aloud keeps going from there.
Scrolls the chat back to the message being read aloud. It does not pause or restart the audio.
Throws away what you said. Nothing is sent or added to the message, and this cannot be undone.
Stops listening and sends the recognized text as a message. Use Paste transcript instead to review it before sending.
Puts the recognized text into the message box without sending it, so you can edit it first.
Puts the recognized text into the message box without sending it.
Tries again to send the recognized text as a message.
Opens Android settings for White Noise, where you can allow microphone access.
Opens Android speech recognition settings, where you can choose or install a recognition service.
Starts listening again. What was recognized before is not added.
Deletes this recording without sending it. This cannot be undone.
Deletes this recording and starts a new one. Nothing is sent.
Stops and deletes the recording without sending it. This cannot be undone.
Stops recording and lets you review it. Nothing is sent until you send it.
Sends the attachments shown here, with your caption, to this chat. Use Done to keep them in the composer instead.
Saves your changes and returns to the composer. Nothing is sent, and items you unticked are removed from the draft.
Closes the preview without sending anything. Attachments you were still preparing to send are discarded.
Opens a menu to add more photos or files to this message.
Opens this chat\'s details, such as its members and settings.
Scrolls to the next unread message that mentions you.
Scrolls the draft back to its first line. It does not change the text.
Searches the emoji list by name.
Opens the settings where you choose your quick reaction emoji.
Adds another answer to the poll, up to the allowed maximum.
Members can vote for one answer only.
Members can vote for more than one answer.
Quotes this message in the composer so your reply is linked to it.
Opens your message in the composer so you can change it.
Turns on selection mode so you can pick several messages at once.
Lets you select part of this message\'s text.
Copies the message text to your phone\'s clipboard.
Opens a panel with a translation. Translation runs on your device through the Offline Translator app.
Reads this message aloud, then continues with the messages after it.
Reads this message aloud with code spoken exactly as written, then continues with the messages after it.
Opens a chat picker. The chats you choose receive a new copy of this message.
Keeps this message in a small card on top of the chat. You can remove the card at any time.
Collapses this long message to a shorter preview.
Opens Android Share with this message. The app you choose receives it and is outside White Noise.
Saves this message\'s attachments to your device.
Shows when this message was sent and received, who sent it, its ID and its status.
Opens a report form for the group admins. Nothing is sent until you confirm, and admins can see who reported.
Lets you delete this message on this device only or for everyone. Deleting for everyone cannot be undone. Nothing is deleted until you choose.
